title: Vehicle Title
description: A state certificate of title for a motor vehicle, including the vehicle description, owner and lienholder, lien release, and the ownership transfer and dealer reassignment sections on the face and back.

issuing_state.description: State or commonwealth that issued the title, as named in the header.

issuing_agency.description: Agency that issued the title, as printed in the header (e.g. Department of Motor Vehicles).

form_number.description: Form identifier printed on the title, e.g. VSA3L.

title_number.description: The certificate's title number, from the TITLE NO. box. Not the security control number marked 'This is not a title number'.

control_number.description: Security or control number printed beside the text 'This is not a title number'.

title_type.description: Title type or status printed on the face, e.g. ORIGINAL or DUPLICATE.

date_issued.description: Date the title was issued, exactly as printed.

date_established.description: Date printed after ESTABLISHED, exactly as printed.

body_type.description: Vehicle body type, e.g. PICKUP or SEDAN.

gvwr.description: Gross vehicle weight rating as printed.

fuel_type.description: Fuel type, e.g. GAS or DIESEL.

odometer_at_titling.description: Odometer reading printed on the face of the title when it was issued, as printed.

odometer_brand.description: Odometer brand, e.g. ACTUAL, NOT ACTUAL or EXCEEDS MECHANICAL LIMITS.

other_pertinent_data.description: Value in the OTHER PERTINENT DATA box.

owners.description: Owners named on the face of the title.

lienholder.description: First lienholder printed on the face of the title, if any.

lien_release.description: Lien release section on the face of the title.

released.description: True when the lien release is signed.

released_by_title.description: Printed name and title of the person who signed the release.

release_date.description: Date of the release, as written.

stamps.description: Text of any rubber stamps applied across the title, e.g. FOR EXPORT ONLY with a dealer name and number.

transfers.description: Each completed ownership transfer, in order: the assignment of title by the owner on the face, then each completed dealer reassignment on the back. Skip blank sections.

section.description: Section letter on the form, e.g. A, B, C.

seller_name.description: Printed name of the seller or selling dealer.

buyer_address.description: Buyer's address on one line, including city, state and ZIP.

odometer_reading.description: Odometer reading written in the transfer, as written.

odometer_certification.description: Which odometer box is checked: ACTUAL, NOT ACTUAL, IN EXCESS OF MECHANICAL LIMITS, EXEMPT, or none.

dealer_number.description: Dealer licence number given in the transfer, if any.
